Data is from here: https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/633e10e5d34e342aee056941
Bouma-Gregson, K., Sturgeon, C.L., Cone, K.M., Uebner, M.Q., Baxter, T.J., Nakatsuka, K., Hansen, A.M., Richardson, E.T., Westrick, J., Szlag Silva, R., Bergamaschi, B.A., and Kraus, T.E.C., 2025, Cyanotoxins in the California Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta: Whole Water Cyanotoxin Samples: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P96L1RTV.

# Download data
```{r}
# Required packages to include
# install.packages("librarian")
librarian::shelf(readr, dplyr, tidyr, here, leaflet, sf, ggplot2, ggspatial, prettymapr, sharpshootR, purrr, tibble, ckanr, lubridate)
```

```{r}
#Read in data

tox_data <- read.delim("data//raw//sciencebase//633e10e5d34e342aee056941//CyanoWW_2025_cyanotoxins.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") 

tox_data$Timestamp..PST..DS <- parse_date_time(tox_data$Timestamp..PST..DS, orders = "mdy HMS")
tox_data$Station.Abbrev. <- tox_data$Station.Abbrev..DS

tox_data_locs <- read.delim("data//raw//sciencebase//633e10e5d34e342aee056941//CyanoWW_2025_stations.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
#merge data
tox_data_2 <- merge(tox_data, tox_data_locs, by = "Station.Abbrev.")

plot(tox_data_2$Result.Value..ug.L.)
plot(tox_data_2$Latitude..Decimal.Degrees..NAD83.)
plot(tox_data_2$Longitude..Decimal.Degrees..NAD83.)
```

```{r}
#export csv
write.csv(tox_data_2, "data//01_processed//01_tox_BGregson.csv")
```
